_comment: Negative control for the adherence checker. The paragraph-arc lens emitted an out-of-lane 'em-dash' finding (em-dash belongs to the tells lens). The adherence checker MUST classify paragraph-arc as drift => adherence FAIL. A test asserts this; if the checker passes this fixture, the build fails. This is what stops a rubber-stamp adherence implementation.
